---
title: "Bangert-Drowns: 48 writing-to-learn studies"
subtitle: "Catalog A-03"
description: "A meta-analysis under five priors on alpha: the study effects and the moderator slopes stay put, while the posterior number of clusters and the chance that all studies share one cluster follow the prior."
toc: false
---

The second application is a meta-analysis: 48 studies of writing-to-learn interventions
(Bangert-Drowns, Hurley, and Wilkinson, 2004). The same Dirichlet process mixture treats the
study effects as draws from an unknown distribution of effects. The paper's target for the
number of clusters is "about 4, between 1 and 8 with 80% probability".

```{=html}

<script src="../../js/vendor/d3.min.js"></script>

  (function () {
    var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search), spec = {};
    if (q.get("preset")) spec.preset = q.get("preset");
    window.__dpxBd = DPX["bd-forest"].mountWidget(document.getElementById("w-bd"), spec);
  })();
```

- **The same pattern as STAR.** From Vague to the Dual-Anchor prior the posterior number of
  clusters goes from 1.89 to 3.31, and the chance that all 48 studies share one cluster from
  .548 to .190, while the study effects move by less than .01 in root mean square and the
  same 13 posterior intervals exclude zero.
- **A classical benchmark.** The random-effects estimate (REML) from the reported effects is
  .222 with a 95% interval [.132, .312] and I² = 58.4%: a heterogeneous literature, which is
  why the number of clusters is worth a prior at all.
- **Moderators.** The slopes of the study effects on grade and on length hardly change with the
  prior (a descriptive alignment, not causal moderation).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Study-level effects and standard errors: `metadat::dat.bangertdrowns2004` (metadat 1.6-0, GPL
&ge; 2), as used by the replication package; posterior summaries and moderator slopes: the
replication package (CC BY 4.0). The random-effects benchmark is computed in the browser from the
released effects and standard errors; it is not a posterior quantity.
:::

Standalone version: [embed/bd-forest.html](../../embed/bd-forest.html) (for example
`?preset=da` or `?preset=moderators`).
